title: THE BACKWARD DIGEST · The tide table
venue: private · after the print tech's misfold of Sept 30, 1999 · Box 23 onward
logline: A page that is a tide table for the month: the columns of highs and lows drawn by hand, and in the margin of each day a thumbnail — the flats at that tide, twenty-eight of them, the pup a dot in each. The reader can find the day they're reading it on. The numbers are shapes; the thumbnails are exact.

panels.composition: A hand-drawn tide table for a month filling the page: rows of days with columns of high and low marks drawn as shapes, and beside each row a small thumbnail of the same mudflats at that tide with a tiny three-legged dog in each, the water's line different in every one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a hand-drawn monthly tide table filling the page with rows of days and columns of tide marks drawn as shapes, each row accompanied by a small thumbnail of the same tidal flats at a different water level with a tiny dog in each, no words legible
image.notes: The numbers are shapes; the thumbnails are exact. Which month: reserved.

art.line: the private line, turned: mirrored, overlaid, folded
art.palette: the private washes; the 1997 xerox black where 1997 is quoted
art.paper: Arches; one page on a printed misfold
